LESSON: AREA (SURFACES OF OBJECTS)

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Measurement
Topic 3.6: Area (Surfaces of Objects)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Area (Surfaces of Objects), part of Measurement in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How many small similar objects can cover a given surface?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Collect in purposive pairs/groups concrete objects (books, manila paper, calendar) found in the market and observe their different surfaces. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to collect objects. Safety of all learners should be observed especially those learners with chronic health conditions and those using mobility devices.

2. Identify surfaces of different objects found in the market as large or small. Safety of all learners should be observed and especially for learners with chronic health conditions and those who are haemophilic.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Collect in purposive pairs/groups concrete objects (books, manila paper, calendar) found in the market and observe their different surfaces. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to collect objects. Safety of all learners should be observed especially those learners with chronic health conditions and those using mobility devices.
2. Identify surfaces of different objects found in the market as large or small. Safety of all learners should be observed and especially for learners with chronic health conditions and those who are haemophilic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Area (Surfaces of Objects) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking and problem solving: learners cover different surfaces using small similar objects and count small similar

objects that cover a given surface.

Values:
Love: learners share concrete object as they work with each other.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: learners amicably work with each other to cover different surfaces using small similar objects.

45

Link to Other Activity Areas:

The learner is able to relate shading or colouring of surfaces of different drawn picture of objects to colouring in Creative

Activities.
